user.title: Select ZhiJin Solar Controller
user.description: Choose a discovered ZhiJin BLE controller or enter its Bluetooth address manually.

data_description.connection_mode: On-Demand connects only during each poll to reduce controller radio power draw and free Bluetooth proxy slots. Persistent keeps the connection open for fastest switch response.
data_description.power_save_mode: Automatically slows down polling when solar/load activity is idle to reduce controller power usage.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to configure the ZhiJin BLE controller {name} ({address})?

manual.title: Manual Bluetooth Address
manual.description: No unconfigured ZhiJin controllers are currently advertising. Enter the Bluetooth MAC address (or UUID) manually.

error.invalid_address: Please enter a valid Bluetooth address.

abort.no_devices_found: No ZhiJin BLE controllers were discovered.

init.title: ZhiJin BLE Settings
init.description: Tune polling intervals, power-saving behavior, and BLE retry parameters.

data_description.connection_mode: on_demand disconnects between polls (best stability & lowest power); persistent stays connected.
data_description.power_save_mode: off: always use normal interval; night_idle: slow down when solar is off and currents are 0; night: slow down whenever solar is off; idle: slow down whenever currents are 0.
data_description.temperature_offset: Offset added to the controller's raw temperature reading (e.g. -5.3 to compensate for internal PCB self-heating).

device_offline.title: ZhiJin BLE controller offline ({name})
device_offline.description: Controller {name} ({address}) has been unreachable over Bluetooth for more than {minutes} minute(s). Check that the controller has power, is within Bluetooth range (or proxy coverage), and that the official mobile app is not holding the exclusive BLE connection.
